records.source: A place to store your items.
A wooden statue of a chicken.
Automatically brews a fresh cup every morning.
records.translation: Awtomatikong nagtitimpla ng sariwang tasa tuwing umaga.

records.preserveReason: The description consists only of an ellipsis and carries no translatable wording.

records.source: Insert a gem of your choice and it will grow copies.
records.translation: Maglagay ng hiyas na gusto mo at magpapatubo ito ng mga kopya.

records.source: Something's not right with this Prairie King Arcade System...
records.translation: May hindi tama sa Arcade System ng Hari ng Kapatagan na ito...

records.source: Use an item on this to change what's displayed. The item won't be consumed.
records.translation: Gumamit ng bagay dito upang baguhin ang ipinapakita. Hindi mauubos ang bagay.

records.source: It's been petrified for a long time, poor thing.
records.translation: Matagal na itong naging bato, kawawa naman.

records.source: Destroys crafted items, but salvages their most valuable material.
records.translation: Sinisira ang mga nilikhang bagay pero binabawi ang pinakamahalagang materyal ng mga ito.

records.source: Place 5 pieces of fruit or edible mushrooms inside to dry them.
records.translation: Maglagay ng 5 piraso ng prutas o nakakain na kabute sa loob upang patuyuin ang mga ito.

records.source: Prevents crows from attacking your crops. Has a large radius (about 16 "tiles").
records.translation: Pinipigilan ang mga uwak na salakayin ang mga pananim mo. Malawak ang saklaw nito (mga 16 "parisukat").

records.source: Produces Deluxe Bait on a regular basis. The worms are self-sufficient.
records.translation: Regular na gumagawa ng Marangyang Pain. Kayang alagaan ng mga uod ang sarili nila.

records.source: A hidden mechanism causes it to retract into the ground.
records.translation: Dahil sa isang nakatagong mekanismo, lumulubog ito sa lupa.

records.source: Part of the glass is shattered.

records.translation: Pabilog na mesang mahusay ang pagkakagawa.

records.source: Scans the farm and displays useful information.
records.translation: Sinusuri ang bukid at nagpapakita ng kapaki-pakinabang na impormasyon.

records.source: Provides convenient access to silo fodder.
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng madaling daan sa kumpay mula sa silo.

records.source: Place fish inside with a piece of coal to create smoked fish, which is worth double. The quality of the fish is preserved.
records.translation: Maglagay ng isda sa loob kasama ang isang piraso ng uling upang gumawa ng pinausukang isda na doble ang halaga. Napananatili ang kalidad ng isda.

records.preserveReason: The value is an intentionally concealed internal placeholder bounded by question marks.
The value is an intentionally concealed internal placeholder bounded by question marks.

records.source: Turns ore and coal into metal bars.
records.translation: Ginagawang mga bareta ng metal ang mineral at uling.

records.source: Grows crops from any season when indoors. Outdoors, it can only house seasonal crops.
records.translation: Nagpapatubo ng mga pananim mula sa anumang panahon kapag nasa loob. Sa labas, mga pananim lamang para sa kasalukuyang panahon ang maaaring itanim dito.
